appearance_facts.fact: Horizontal axis spans 2006 to 2018; vertical axis is inverted with 0 at top and 8 near bottom; a blue line with circular markers runs across the lower plot area, with a light purple fill above it.
The marker at 2010 appears slightly higher on the page than the markers at 2006, 2008, 2009, 2011, and 2013.
The marker at 2015 appears lowest on the page among all yearly markers.
The 2018 marker is near the bottom of the line, close to the 2017 marker.
The filled region occupies most of the chart above the line, making the line sit near the bottom edge.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'Year vs. Mortality rate'; x-axis label: 'Year'; y-axis label: 'Count'.
Visible tick labels: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, with 0 at the top and values increasing downward.
No numeric point labels are printed; the only readable reference points are the axis ticks and the relative vertical positions of the markers.

public_definitions: Use the yearly mortality trend in the chart to determine which reporting year warrants escalation, then select the corresponding routing option.
Primary field: Peak-burden year follow-up route
Options include escalating 2018, escalating 2010, or escalating the chart for methodology reference review.
uncertain: The y-axis is inverted, so 'higher on the page' does not equal a larger count; the exact mortality value for each year is not labeled.
Whether the intended 'peak burden' corresponds to the largest count (lowest on this inverted axis) or the visually highest marker is not explicitly defined.
